items.question: What is the minimum age of students that an establishment may train under UAE Administrative Resolution No. 22 of 2022 on training minors?
items.fact: Establishments may train students aged 15 and above

items.question: What is the maximum period of consecutive months for which an establishment may recruit students during academic holidays under UAE Administrative Resolution No. 22 of 2022?
items.gold: Maximum three consecutive months each time.
items.fact: Student recruitment during holidays capped at three consecutive months
